title: Ames, IA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ames, IA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ames is a city in IA with a population of 66,000. Home of Iowa State University with a strong engineering program and college-town vibe. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.3.
